head: 176dcf38
label: CP7_OW12A_FINANCE_CAPTURE_NATIVE7
error: must be able to SET ROLE "cp7_capture"
traceback_tail: composition.py line 91 in install: cur.execute(text) -> psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege
predecessor_definitions_on_install_failu: present, 5 bodies (report_run_unit, report_step, report_status, report_summary_text, run_next)
cause: Installer, not product: the first fix (176dcf38) ran the stage SQL as postgres, as E25j asks, but the harness creates cp7_capture and cp7_finance_read as supabase_admin, so postgres is not a member of them and 'create schema ... authorization cp7_capture' is refused. A CP7C install as postgres with createrole_self_grant='set, inherit' would make postgres a member. No case ran.
fix: composition.handover: where postgres lacks SET and INHERIT membership of exactly these two roles, the session superuser grants it for the install (and pre-use removal) transaction and revokes it before the catalog is read again; the DDL still runs as postgres and the role owners, and the 22-group catalog (role memberships included) must equal the admitted delta. Checked on local PostgreSQL 16: without the grant the hand-over is refused with the same message; with it the schema, table and function hand-over and a replace as the owner succeed; after the revoke no membership row remains.
